title: Advil vs Life Brand Ibuprofen 200mg

brand.product: Advil Regular Strength Tablets, Ibuprofen 200 mg

alternative.product: Life Brand Regular Strength Ibuprofen USP 200 mg, 100 Tablets

summary: Both are regular-strength ibuprofen 200 mg tablets, and Life Brand is Shoppers Drug Mart and Loblaw's own label.
evidence: Both prices are from the same Loblaws (loblaws.ca) search listing on 2026-11-02: Advil Tablets, 50 ct, $12.49 ($0.25 each), and Life Brand Regular Strength Ibuprofen USP 200 mg, 100 tablets, $6.49. The Life Brand listing states ibuprofen USP 200 mg. Walmart.ca lists the same Advil Regular Strength tablets as '200 mg Ibuprofen', which is the strength of every plain Advil tablet sold in Canada.
differences: Advil tablets have a sugar coating. Life Brand's inactive ingredients and coating may differ. The Life Brand pack is twice the size.

title: Advil vs Equate Ibuprofen 200mg

brand.product: Advil Regular Strength Tablets, 200 mg Ibuprofen, 24 Count

summary: Both are plain ibuprofen 200 mg tablets sold at Walmart.ca.
evidence: Walmart.ca listings checked on 2026-11-02: Advil Regular Strength Tablets, 200 mg ibuprofen, 24 count, $5.97, and Equate Ibuprofen Tablet 200 mg, 120 tablets, $11.28. Both product names state ibuprofen 200 mg. The Equate caplet version (120 caplets) is the same price.
differences: The Advil pack checked is small (24 tablets). Larger Advil packs cost less per tablet, so the gap narrows a little. Coating and inactive ingredients may differ.

title: Imodium Liqui-Gels vs Life Brand Diarrhea Relief Liquid Gels 2mg

brand.product: Imodium Liqui-Gels, Loperamide Hydrochloride 2 mg, 60 Liquid Capsules

alternative.product: Life Brand Diarrhea Relief Liquid Gels 2 mg, 24 Capsules

summary: Both are 2 mg loperamide liquid-gel capsules for diarrhea, the same dose and form.
evidence: Loblaws (loblaws.ca) search for 'loperamide' on 2026-11-02 listed Imodium Liqui-Gels 60 ct at $47.99 ($0.80 each) and Life Brand Diarrhea Relief Liquid Gels 2 mg, 24 capsules, at $7.99 ($0.33 each). Walmart.ca's Imodium Liqui-Gels listing states loperamide hydrochloride 2 mg. Life Brand's diarrhea-relief range at Shoppers Drug Mart is loperamide hydrochloride, but the Loblaws liquid-gel listing names only the 2 mg strength, not the active, so check the box says loperamide.
differences: Compared with Imodium's biggest (cheapest per capsule) pack. Against the 24-count Imodium ($32.99) the saving is larger. Inactive ingredients in the capsule shell may differ.

title: Claritin vs Life Brand 24 Hour Allergy Remedy (Loratadine 10mg)

brand.product: Claritin Allergy Medicine, 24-Hour Non-Drowsy Relief, Loratadine 10 mg, 50 Tablets

alternative.product: Life Brand 24 Hour Allergy Remedy (loratadine 10 mg), 85 Tablets

summary: Both are once-a-day non-drowsy loratadine 10 mg tablets.
evidence: Loblaws (loblaws.ca) listed Claritin 24-Hour Non-Drowsy 50 ct at $37.99 ($0.76 each) and Life Brand 24 Hour Allergy Remedy 85 ct at $32.99 ($0.39 each) on 2026-11-02, and Claritin's 30-count listing states 10 mg. Health Canada's Drug Product Database has exactly one product named '24 HOUR ALLERGY REMEDY' (DIN 02280159, Vita Health Products), and its only active is loratadine 10 mg. The Loblaws listing doesn't print the DIN, so check the box for DIN 02280159 or 'loratadine 10 mg'.
differences: Claritin is cheaper at Walmart.ca, where the 95-tablet pack was $39.97 ($0.42 each), but Life Brand still costs less per tablet. Inactive ingredients may differ.

title: Tylenol Extra Strength vs Life Brand Acetaminophen 500mg

alternative.product: Life Brand Extra Strength Acetaminophen 500 mg, 500 Tablets

title: Reactine Extra Strength vs Life Brand Cetirizine 10mg

brand.product: Reactine Extra Strength Tablets, Cetirizine Hydrochloride 10 mg, 84 Count

alternative.product: Life Brand Extra Strength Allergy Relief Cetirizine Hydrochloride Tablets, 84 Count

summary: Both are extra-strength cetirizine hydrochloride tablets. In Canada, 'Extra Strength' cetirizine means 10 mg.
evidence: Loblaws (loblaws.ca) on 2026-11-02 listed Reactine Tablets Extra Strength 10 mg, 84 ct, at $54.99 ($0.65 each) and Life Brand Extra Strength Allergy Relief Cetirizine Hydrochloride Tablets, 84 ct, at $33.99 ($0.40 each). The Life Brand name says 'Extra Strength' but doesn't print the mg. In Canada, cetirizine comes as Regular Strength 5 mg or Extra Strength 10 mg, and a same-named 'Extra Strength Allergy Relief' product (Kirkland, DIN 02315955) is cetirizine 10 mg.
differences: Same tablet count. Reactine's 120-count pack ($62.99 at Loblaws) and Walmart.ca's Reactine 120-count ($46.77 on sale) cost less per tablet, which shrinks or removes the saving. Inactive ingredients may differ.

title: RestoraLAX vs Life Brand ClearLax (PEG 3350)

alternative.product: Life Brand ClearLax Polyethylene Glycol 3350 Powder for Oral Solution, 765 g

summary: Both are pure polyethylene glycol 3350 powder, the same osmotic laxative, in the same 765 g size.
evidence: Health Canada's Drug Product Database lists RestoraLAX (DIN 02318164, Bayer) with a single active, polyethylene glycol 3350 at 100% w/w. The Life Brand ClearLax listing names polyethylene glycol 3350 powder for oral solution. Loblaws (loblaws.ca) on 2026-11-02 listed RestoraLAX 45 doses at $37.99 ($4.97/100 g, which is 765 g) and Life Brand ClearLax 765 g at $28.99 ($3.79/100 g). Walmart.ca confirms the RestoraLAX 45-dose pack is 765 g.
differences: None in the powder itself. The packaging and measuring cap differ.

title: Aleve vs Life Brand Naproxen 220mg

alternative.product: Life Brand Naproxen 220 mg Caplets, 24 Count

title: Nicorette 2mg vs Life Brand Nicotine Gum 2mg

alternative.product: Life Brand Menthol Nicotine Gum 2 mg, 210 Chewing Gums

summary: Both are 2 mg nicotine replacement gum in a 210-piece pack.
evidence: Loblaws (loblaws.ca) on 2026-11-02 listed Nicorette Nicotine Gum Mint 2 mg, 210 ct, at $72.99 regular ($69.99 on sale), and Life Brand Menthol Nicotine Gum 2 mg, 210 ct, at $62.99.
